res_fb32e64db911.sql:
WITH base AS (
SELECT "customer_segment" AS "customer_segment", 100.0 * SUM(is_returned) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "return_rate"
FROM (
SELECT
  o.order_id,
  o.order_date,
  o.customer_id,
  o.channel            AS order_channel,
  o.discount_rate,
  o.shipping_cost,
  o.status,
  o.is_first_order,
  i.order_item_id,
  i.product_id,
  i.quantity,
  i.unit_price,
  i.unit_cost,
  i.list_price,
  i.discount_amount,
  p.category,
  p.brand,
  c.region,
  c.customer_segment,
  c.acquisition_channel,
  CASE WHEN r.return_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_returned,
  COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)                    AS refund_amount,
  r.return_reason
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p    ON p.product_id = i.product_id
JOIN customers c   ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = i.order_item_id
) AS m
GROUP BY "customer_segment"
ORDER BY "customer_segment"
)
SELECT "customer_segment", "return_rate",
  CASE WHEN MIN("return_rate") OVER () >= 0 THEN
    ROUND(100.0 * "return_rate" / NULLIF(SUM("return_rate") OVER (), 0), 4)
  END AS share_of_total_pct,
  ROUND("return_rate" - MAX("return_rate") OVER (), 6) AS diff_vs_best,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "return_rate" DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank_desc
FROM base
ORDER BY "return_rate" DESC NULLS LAST

res_8eaf50a407d5.sql:
WITH base AS (
SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS period, 100.0 * SUM(is_returned) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "return_rate"
FROM (
SELECT
  o.order_id,
  o.order_date,
  o.customer_id,
  o.channel            AS order_channel,
  o.discount_rate,
  o.shipping_cost,
  o.status,
  o.is_first_order,
  i.order_item_id,
  i.product_id,
  i.quantity,
  i.unit_price,
  i.unit_cost,
  i.list_price,
  i.discount_amount,
  p.category,
  p.brand,
  c.region,
  c.customer_segment,
  c.acquisition_channel,
  CASE WHEN r.return_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_returned,
  COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)                    AS refund_amount,
  r.return_reason
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p    ON p.product_id = i.product_id
JOIN customers c   ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = i.order_item_id
) AS m
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', order_date)
ORDER BY date_trunc('month', order_date)
)
SELECT period, "return_rate",
  LAG("return_rate") OVER (ORDER BY period) AS prev_period,
  ROUND("return_rate" - LAG("return_rate") OVER (ORDER BY period), 6) AS change_abs,
  ROUND(100.0 * ("return_rate" - LAG("return_rate") OVER (ORDER BY period))
        / NULLIF(ABS(LAG("return_rate") OVER (ORDER BY period)), 0), 4) AS change_pct
FROM base
ORDER BY period
